units.title: Watch session recordings for user insight

claim.text: The source says Clarity's recording data lets you watch recordings of users on your site and get a ton of insight.
claim.quote: watch recordings of users on your site and get a ton of insight from that

action.text: Click on recordings to watch them.
action.quote: what you want to do is click on recordings

unknowns: Source does not state a required number or duration before insight is gained.

units.title: Filter recordings by behavior and context

claim.text: The source lists filters for time frame, device, user action such as dead clicks, rage clicks, and excessive scrolling, scroll depth, landing page, performance/speed, and page duration.
claim.quote: I can filter by the time frame the device I can do it by the user action so dead clicks rage clicks excessive scrolling I can do it based on how far they scroll what page they land on right their performance like the the website speed if I want to see people that are coming from low speed experiences versus high speed how do they interact differently page duration all of these different filters

action.text: Use the available filters to narrow recordings by time frame, device, user action, scroll depth, landing page, performance/speed, and page duration.
action.quote: I can filter by the time frame the device I can do it by the user action so dead clicks rage clicks excessive scrolling I can do it based on how far they scroll what page they land on right their performance like the the website speed if I want to see people that are coming from low speed experiences versus high speed how do they interact differently page duration all of these different filters

unknowns: Source does not specify exact filter names or current availability in Clarity.

units.title: Sort recordings by activity extremes

claim.text: The source says to sort by clicks and pages high-to-low and then low-to-high to identify very active and less active users and get both sides of the coin.
claim.quote: what I'm trying to identify is people that are very active on the site what are they doing and then people that are not as active what are they doing right and then that gives me both sides of the coin and both sides of the perspective

action.text: Click on sort, go by clicks high to low and Pages high to low, then do the opposite: clicks low to high and Pages low to high.
action.quote: click on sort and then go by clicks high to low Pages high to low and then also do the opposite so clicks low to high and then Pages low to high

unknowns: Source does not state how many recordings to review at each extreme.

units.title: Use skip-inactivity setting based on watching goal

claim.text: The source says they like to skip in activities sometimes, new users can keep it off to see parts where people are not moving, and they are using it now to get quick insight from a long recording.
claim.quote: I like to skip in activities sometimes you know if you're watching this for the first time or you're new to Clarity you can keep that off because it's going to show you the parts where people aren't moving at all but right now I'm just trying to get you show you guys like how to get quick Insight from this

action.text: Use skip-inactivity sometimes to get quick insight; if watching for the first time or new to Clarity, keep it off to see non-movement periods.
action.quote: I like to skip in activities sometimes you know if you're watching this for the first time or you're new to Clarity you can keep that off because it's going to show you the parts where people aren't moving at all but right now I'm just trying to get you show you guys like how to get quick Insight from this

args.text: The recording is very long and you want quick insight.
args.quote: because it's a super long recording

args.text: You are watching for the first time or are new to Clarity.
args.quote: if you're watching this for the first time or you're new to Clarity

unknowns: The source uses the phrase 'skip in activities' and does not clarify whether this is the exact UI label or a transcription variant.

units.title: Make filter reachable without scrolling back to top

claim.text: The source observed users repeatedly scrolling back to the top to access a filter that only appears at the top and is not sticky.
claim.quote: they have to scroll down for all the products then they have to scroll all the way back up just to access the filter because the filter is only on the top of the site it's not anywhere else it's not like a sticky filter

action.text: Make the filter sticky on the page.
action.quote: that could very much be sticky on the page

args.text: Recordings show users repeatedly scrolling back to the top to access the filter.
args.quote: they have to scroll down for all the products then they have to scroll all the way back up just to access the filter

unknowns: Source does not specify implementation details for making the filter sticky.

units.title: Fix cart loss when switching menus

claim.text: The source describes a usability issue where switching from full menu to on demand removed the cart after a warning, causing the user to lose products and leave.
claim.quote: when people switch from on demand to sorry full menu to on demand it actually removed their cart it gave them a warning in a popup but by the time they saw that warning it already removed their cart

action.text: Fix the cart-removal issue straight away.
action.quote: obviously this is something that had to get fixed straight away

args.text: A recorded user switched menus and lost all products, then left the site after 21 minutes.
args.quote: they literally left the site after spending 21 minutes on the site they just left it

unknowns: Source does not state the fix mechanism or expected cart behavior after the fix.

units.title: Focus on recordings with a why mindset

claim.text: The source recommends removing distractions for one to two hours, focusing on recordings, and asking why someone did each action.
claim.quote: try and remove all your distractions for the next one to two hours just focus on the recordings and really try and go in with the mindset of why right like ask yourself why and everything why did someone do this why did someone click here what could be the possible reasons

action.text: Remove distractions for one to two hours, focus on recordings, and ask why for each observed behavior.
action.quote: try and remove all your distractions for the next one to two hours just focus on the recordings and really try and go in with the mindset of why right like ask yourself why and everything why did someone do this why did someone click here what could be the possible reasons

unknowns: Source does not define a minimum number of why questions to ask per recording.

units.title: Watch until main pattern is found, then stop

claim.text: The source says there is no set number of recordings; some watch 100 and others 400-450, but the true number is however many it takes to understand the main pattern and friction points, after which watching becomes repetitive.
claim.quote: there's no set number for some people we like some clients we watch like 100 recordings for others we watch like 400 450 like rapid fire and really what you're just trying to look for and the the true number is however many recordings it takes you to understand the main pattern that people are going through like what are the main issues what are the main friction points once you identify those you don't need to continue watching any more recordings it gets repetitive after a certain point

action.text: Watch as many recordings as it takes to understand the main patterns and friction points, then stop once the pattern is identified and further watching becomes repetitive.
action.quote: there's no set number for some people we like some clients we watch like 100 recordings for others we watch like 400 450 like rapid fire and really what you're just trying to look for and the the true number is however many recordings it takes you to understand the main pattern that people are going through like what are the main issues what are the main friction points once you identify those you don't need to continue watching any more recordings it gets repetitive after a certain point

completion.text: The main pattern and friction points are identified.
completion.quote: once you identify those you don't need to continue watching any more recordings it gets repetitive after a certain point

unknowns: Source does not define a quantitative threshold for the main pattern.
